🚨🗣️ Flick: "We missed some chances in some periods, especially during the first half, and we also made some mistakes in the build-up play. But in the end, I am satisfied with the performance, as are the members of my technical staff and my assistants, and we are all happy with what the team delivered”

🚨🗣️ Hansi Flick, on Marcus Rashford's departure: “I'm very grateful to have worked with him. There's always some uncertainty with loan deals. He's a fantastic player and an even better person. We'll miss him.” https://t.co/3PEi5RdtK9

🚨🗣️ Flick: "Hamza? You can see that he has great potential, just like the rest of the players. For me, the most important thing is for them to demonstrate the quality of their potential on the pitch and to apply what they already possess and that's something I truly appreciate. The technical quality is good, as is the sharpness in performance and the atmosphere within the team. Working with these young players truly gives me great pleasure."

🚨🗣️ Flick: "Did I contact Ferran? We were in contact with him during the World Cup, but now he is on his vacation, and I respect that. He has the right to enjoy his vacation. And of course, he is a player in our ranks, and he proved in many matches of the past season just how important he is to us, and this is exactly what we expect from him and want him to continue."

🚨🗣️ Flick: "Karim? I think he has much greater potential than what he's shown, and he can showcase his strengths better, but he's still in his first week of training, and that's natural. In the training sessions, I see Karim at a much better level. His speed and his ability to finish attacks are among his standout strengths, and it's good to see that. In the end, he has great potential, and I also believe he's capable of giving a lot to the team."
